mapper.select: SELECT * FROM wf_process_task WHERE process_instance_id = #{processInstanceId} ORDER BY create_time ASC

SELECT t.*, t.task_key as business_key, NULL as business_type, NULL as process_definition_name FROM wf_process_task t WHERE t.assignee_user_id = #{assigneeUserId} AND t.task_status = 'PENDING' AND t.task_key IS NOT NULL -- 只显示当前节点的任务（确保不存在更早的待处理节点） AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wf_process_task prev WHERE prev.task_key = t.task_key AND prev.task_status = 'PENDING' AND ( (prev.print_order IS NOT NULL AND t.print_order IS NOT NULL AND prev.print_order < t.print_order) OR (prev.print_order IS NOT NULL AND t.print_order IS NULL) OR (prev.print_order IS NULL AND t.print_order IS NULL AND prev.create_time < t.create_time) ) ) ORDER BY COALESCE(t.print_order, 999999) ASC, t.create_time ASC

SELECT DISTINCT t.*, t.task_key as business_key, NULL as business_type, NULL as process_definition_name FROM wf_process_task t WHERE t.assignee_user_id = #{assigneeUserId} AND t.task_status = #{taskStatus} AND t.task_key IS NOT NULL ORDER BY t.complete_time DESC, t.create_time DESC

SELECT t.*, t.task_key as business_key, NULL as business_type, NULL as process_definition_name FROM wf_process_task t WHERE t.task_key = #{businessKey} ORDER BY COALESCE(t.print_order, 999999) ASC, t.create_time ASC

SELECT t.*, t.task_key as business_key, NULL as business_type, NULL as process_definition_name FROM wf_process_task t WHERE t.task_status = 'PENDING' AND t.task_key IS NOT NULL -- 只显示当前节点的任务（确保不存在更早的待处理节点） AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wf_process_task prev WHERE prev.task_key = t.task_key AND prev.task_status = 'PENDING' AND ( (prev.print_order IS NOT NULL AND t.print_order IS NOT NULL AND prev.print_order < t.print_order) OR (prev.print_order IS NOT NULL AND t.print_order IS NULL) OR (prev.print_order IS NULL AND t.print_order IS NULL AND prev.create_time < t.create_time) ) ) ORDER BY COALESCE(t.print_order, 999999) ASC, t.create_time ASC

SELECT t.*, i.business_key, i.business_type, d.definition_name as process_definition_name FROM wf_process_task t LEFT JOIN wf_process_instance i ON t.process_instance_id = i.instance_id LEFT JOIN wf_process_definition d ON i.process_definition_id = d.definition_id WHERE t.task_status = #{taskStatus} ORDER BY t.create_time DESC

SELECT t.*, i.business_key, i.business_type, d.definition_name as process_definition_name FROM wf_process_task t LEFT JOIN wf_process_instance i ON t.process_instance_id = i.instance_id LEFT JOIN wf_process_definition d ON i.process_definition_id = d.definition_id WHERE t.process_instance_id = #{processInstanceId} AND t.task_status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY t.create_time ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT t.*, i.business_key, i.business_type, d.definition_name as process_definition_name FROM wf_process_task t LEFT JOIN wf_process_instance i ON t.process_instance_id = i.instance_id LEFT JOIN wf_process_definition d ON i.process_definition_id = d.definition_id WHERE t.task_status = #{taskStatus} ORDER BY t.create_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}

SELECT t.*, i.business_key, i.business_type, d.definition_name as process_definition_name FROM wf_process_task t LEFT JOIN wf_process_instance i ON t.process_instance_id = i.instance_id LEFT JOIN wf_process_definition d ON i.process_definition_id = d.definition_id WHERE i.business_key = #{businessKey} ORDER BY t.create_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM wf_process_task t LEFT JOIN wf_process_instance i ON t.process_instance_id = i.instance_id WHERE i.business_key = #{businessKey}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wf_process_task (task_id, process_instance_id, task_key, task_name, next_task_id, assignee_user_id, assignee_user_name, assignee_emp_code, assignee_type, position_code, dept_code, candidate_users, task_status, task_type, approval_type, approver_list, approved_list, need_print, print_order, parent_task_id, is_addsign_task, allow_addsign, allow_transfer, allow_reject, allow_reduce_sign, priority, due_date, comment, approver_signature, return_type, complete_time, create_time) VALUES (#{taskId}, #{processInstanceId}, #{taskKey}, #{taskName}, #{nextTaskId}, #{assigneeUserId}, #{assigneeUserName}, #{assigneeEmpCode}, #{assigneeType}, #{positionCode}, #{deptCode}, #{candidateUsers}, #{taskStatus}, #{taskType}, #{approvalType}, #{approverList}, #{approvedList}, #{needPrint}, #{printOrder}, #{parentTaskId}, #{isAddsignTask}, #{allowAddsign}, #{allowTransfer}, #{allowReject}, #{allowReduceSign}, #{priority}, #{dueDate}, #{comment}, #{approverSignature}, #{returnType}, #{completeTime}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM wf_process_task WHERE task_key = #{taskKey} ORDER BY create_time ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE wf_process_task SET task_status = 'TERMINATED', update_time = NOW() WHERE task_key = #{taskKey} AND task_status = 'PENDING'
